content: .{@-अर्थः@} .²1 the meaning of a word. .²2 a thing or object. .²3 a head or topic (of which the Naiyāyikas enumerate 16 subheads). .²4 anything which can be named (अभिधेय), a category or predicament; the number of such categories, according to the Vaiśeṣikas, is seven; according to the Sāṅkhyas, twenty-five (or twenty-seven according to the followers of Patañjali), and two according to the Vedāntins. .²5 the sense of another word which is not expressed but has to be supplied.
